weeks.title: 行业进展｜2026-11-23
weeks.coverage: 2026-11-09 至 2026-11-23（北京时间；近 7 天为主，国际产品动态轻度放宽至 14 天）
weeks.nature: 行业动态/公开资料，非性能数据。内容摘自「防污行业周报」，均已在原始来源核对日期与内容。
weeks.trend_summary: 本周的主题是「无杀生剂路线加速产品化，含杀生剂路线加速受限」：AkzoNobel 在 METSTRADE 推出可直接重涂的无杀生剂游艇漆 Micron ReGen，Hempel 则以独立生命周期评估为既有混合体系背书，GIT 的石墨烯涂层+机器人梳理也拿出了完整年度的实船运行数据——三条线共同指向不依赖杀生剂的船体性能管理正在从概念走向可采购、可施工的产品与服务。与此同时，欧盟以（EU）2026/2567 号决定正式关闭 medetomidine 的续批并定下 2027 年 6 月 8 日的退市线，与上期新西兰的咨询形成对照：同一活性物的准入版图正在按司法辖区分化。监管层面，九大航运协会联合呼吁全球碳规则，MEPC 85 与 12 月 4 日复会表决在即，船体阻力每增加一点都可能直接转化为合规成本——这正是高效防污与主动船体管理共同的经济底色。国内专利层面仍以有机硅杂化等渐进路线为主，未见可对标的实海级突破。

entries.title: 欧盟正式决定不予续批 medetomidine（Selektope），含该活性物防污漆退出欧盟市场进入倒计时
entries.summary: 欧盟委员会 11 月 19 日通过、11 月 20 日刊登于官方公报的执行决定（EU）2026/2567，正式不予续批 medetomidine（商品名 Selektope）作为产品类型 21（防污产品）杀生剂活性物质的批准；决定于 2026 年 12 月 10 日生效，配套决定（EU）2026/2566 同时废止此前将批准延至 2026 年 12 月 31 日的延期；自 2027 年 6 月 8 日起，经该物质处理或有意掺入该物质的物品不得再投放欧盟市场。决定依据为欧洲化学品管理局 2024 年 5 月关于内分泌干扰特性的意见：未能确立安全暴露水平，也未能认定代表性产品的风险可接受。决定同时列出四种被认为对商船与游艇充分可用的化学替代品：DCOIT、硫氰酸铜、氧化亚铜与 tralopyril。已涂装 Selektope 涂层的船舶不受影响，可继续挂靠欧盟港口；I-Tech 称欧盟市场约占其销售额 4%，约 95% 的全球商船队可继续使用含 Selektope 涂层（企业口径）。这是上期新西兰 EPA 就同一活性物启动公众咨询后，欧盟方向的正式落定。
entries.relevance_reason: Selektope 准入分化正式落定：欧盟以立法决定关闭续批并给出明确退市时间表，含杀生剂路线的区域合规风险从「投票意向」变为「已生效决定」，直接影响含该活性物产品的欧洲市场与配方替代选择
entries.note: 待复核（短名单含 Selektope 产品的区域准入表述；未改评级）
entries.title_en: EU formally decides not to renew medetomidine (Selektope); countdown begins for antifouling paints containing the substance to exit the EU market
entries.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2567, adopted by the European Commission on 19 November and published in the Official Journal on 20 November, formally does not renew the approval of medetomidine (trade name Selektope) as a biocidal active substance for product type 21 (antifouling products); the decision takes effect on 10 December 2026, and the accompanying Decision (EU) 2026/2566 simultaneously repeals the earlier extension that had prolonged the approval to 31 December 2026; from 8 June 2027, articles treated with, or intentionally incorporating, that substance may no longer be placed on the EU market. The decision rests on the European Chemicals Agency's May 2024 opinion concerning endocrine-disrupting properties: no safe exposure level could be established, nor could the risks of representative products be deemed acceptable. The decision also lists four chemical alternatives considered adequately available for commercial shipping and yachts: DCOIT, copper thiocyanate, cuprous oxide and tralopyril. Vessels already coated with Selektope coatings are unaffected and may continue to call at EU ports; I-Tech states that the EU market accounts for about 4% of its sales and that about 95% of the global commercial fleet can continue to use Selektope-containing coatings (company figures). This is the formal EU outcome following last issue's public consultation by the New Zealand EPA on the same active substance.
entries.relevance_reason_en: the split in Selektope access is now formally settled: the EU has closed the renewal by legislative decision and set a clear market-exit timetable, so the regional compliance risk for biocide-containing routes has shifted from "voting intention" to "decision in force", directly affecting the European market and formulation substitution choices for products containing this active substance
entries.note_en: Pending review (regional market-access wording for Selektope-containing products on the shortlist; ratings unchanged)

entries.title: Jotun 中标 Knutsen 九艘 LNG 新造船涂料项目
entries.summary: Jotun 11 月 18 日宣布中标 Knutsen 九艘 174,000 立方米 LNG 运输船新造船涂料供应，船舶由韩国韩华海洋建造，2027 年 1 月起切割钢板。项目选用 Jotun Hull Performance Solutions（HPS 2.0），船东在评标中重点考察防污技术与涂层长期性能；Jotun 强调从规格、建造到运营全程的性能承诺。这是 Jotun 与 Knutsen 在挪威与韩国船厂多项目合作的延续。
entries.relevance_reason: 头部船东在大型 LNG 新造船评标中把防污技术与长期船体性能作为重点，印证「可验证船体性能」已成为新造船涂料选型的显性标准
entries.note: 待复核（短名单 Jotun Hull Performance Solutions/SeaQuantum 体系叙事；未改评级）
entries.title_en: Jotun wins the coating contract for Knutsen's nine LNG newbuildings
entries.summary_en: On 18 November, Jotun announced it had won the contract to supply coatings for Knutsen's nine 174,000 m³ LNG carrier newbuildings, to be built by Hanwha Ocean in South Korea, with steel cutting starting in January 2027. The project selected Jotun Hull Performance Solutions (HPS 2.0), and the owner placed particular emphasis on antifouling technology and long-term coating performance in its bid evaluation; Jotun stressed its performance commitment across specification, construction and operation. This continues Jotun and Knutsen's multi-project cooperation at shipyards in Norway and South Korea.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a leading owner making antifouling technology and long-term hull performance a focus in bid evaluation for large LNG newbuildings confirms that "verifiable hull performance" has become an explicit criterion in newbuilding coating selection
entries.note_en: Pending review (shortlist narrative on the Jotun Hull Performance Solutions / SeaQuantum system; ratings unchanged)

entries.title: 九大航运协会联合呼吁就 IMO 净零框架达成全球协议，MEPC 85 将于 11 月 30 日开幕
entries.summary: BIMCO、CLIA、IBIA、ICS、INTERCARGO、INTERFERRY、INTERTANKO、IPTA 与世界航运理事会九大协会 11 月 18 日发表联合声明，敦促各国政府就 IMO 净零框架达成「切实、可执行、稳定」的全球规则，强调唯有全球规则才能避免区域规则碎片化与重复收费。MEPC 85 将于 11 月 30 日至 12 月 3 日在伦敦举行，但通过表决不在其议程内；2025 年 10 月休会的第二次特别会议拟于 12 月 4 日复会并表决 MARPOL 附则 VI 修正案，是否复会须由 MEPC 85 先行确认。草案对 2028–2030 年设定了每吨 CO₂ 当量 100 美元与 380 美元两档补救单位底价，生效日 2028 年 5 月 1 日仍在方括号中，未定。
entries.relevance_reason: 全球碳定价若落地将直接抬高船体阻力增加的合规成本，强化高效防污与船体性能管理的经济价值；但 12 月 4 日能否表决仍不确定，美国等国明确反对
entries.title_en: Nine shipping associations jointly call for a global agreement on the IMO net-zero framework; MEPC 85 opens on 30 November
entries.summary_en: On 18 November, nine associations — BIMCO, CLIA, IBIA, ICS, INTERCARGO, INTERFERRY, INTERTANKO, IPTA and the World Shipping Council — issued a joint statement urging governments to reach "workable, enforceable and stable" global rules on the IMO net-zero framework, stressing that only global rules can avoid fragmentation of regional rules and double charging. MEPC 85 will be held in London from 30 November to 3 December, but an adoption vote is not on its agenda; the second extraordinary session, which adjourned in October 2025, is planned to resume on 4 December to vote on the MARPOL Annex VI amendments, and whether it resumes must first be confirmed by MEPC 85. The draft sets, for 2028–2030, two tiers of remedial-unit floor prices at USD 100 and USD 380 per tonne of CO₂ equivalent, and the entry-into-force date of 1 May 2028 remains in square brackets, undecided.
entries.relevance_reason_en: if global carbon pricing is implemented, it will directly raise the compliance cost of increased hull resistance, strengthening the economic value of efficient antifouling and hull performance management; but whether a vote can take place on 4 December is still uncertain, and the United States and other countries are clearly opposed

entries.title: 无氟激光超疏水涂层论文刊出：飞秒激光+点状有机无机增强
entries.summary: Progress in Organic Coatings 刊出研究（文章号 110466）：7075 铝合金经飞秒激光织构形成仿生菜花状多级结构，KH550 硅烷形成 Al-O-Si 界面锚定层，KH570 改性 ZnO 与低固含 E44 环氧构建点状增强骨架，十八烷基三甲氧基硅烷提供低表面能外层，全程不含氟化改性剂；优化涂层水接触角 163.4°、滚动角 2.1°，240 次磨耗与 200 次胶带剥离后仍保持超疏水，3.5% NaCl 浸泡 100 小时后防腐效率 99.86%（电化学阻抗法），–20°C 结冰延迟由 181 秒延至 857 秒、冰附着强度由 142 kPa 降至 34 kPa。防污仅为潜在应用方向，未做海洋生物附着试验。
entries.relevance_reason: 无氟超疏水界面的耐久性思路与防污表面设计相关，但对象为铝合金实验室样件，无实海防污证据，与船体防污配方选型间接相关
entries.title_en: Paper on a fluorine-free laser superhydrophobic coating published: femtosecond laser + point-like organic–inorganic reinforcement
entries.summary_en: A study published in Progress in Organic Coatings (article 110466): 7075 aluminium alloy was textured by femtosecond laser into a biomimetic cauliflower-like multi-scale structure; KH550 silane formed an Al-O-Si interfacial anchoring layer; KH570-modified ZnO and low-solids E44 epoxy built a point-like reinforcing skeleton; and octadecyltrimethoxysilane provided the low-surface-energy outer layer, with no fluorinated modifiers used anywhere in the process. The optimised coating had a water contact angle of 163.4° and a sliding angle of 2.1°, remained superhydrophobic after 240 abrasion cycles and 200 tape-peeling cycles, achieved an anticorrosion efficiency of 99.86% after 100 hours of immersion in 3.5% NaCl (by electrochemical impedance), delayed icing at −20 °C from 181 seconds to 857 seconds, and reduced ice adhesion strength from 142 kPa to 34 kPa. Antifouling is only a potential application direction; no marine organism attachment tests were carried out.
entries.relevance_reason_en: the durability thinking behind fluorine-free superhydrophobic interfaces is relevant to antifouling surface design, but the subject is a laboratory aluminium-alloy specimen with no real-sea antifouling evidence, indirectly related to hull antifouling formulation selection

entries.title: Neptune Robotics 与 Louis Dreyfus 合作，在新加坡试验 AI 船体清洗机器人
entries.summary: Louis Dreyfus Company（LDC）与 Neptune Robotics 达成合作，在新加坡海事及港务管理局（MPA）的水下船体检查与清洗创新计划下开展机器人船体清洗试验，为期 18 个月；LDC 将开放其 300 余艘租用船舶参与实船测试，评估 AI 驱动机器人的检查与清洗性能及对燃油消耗与排放的影响，结果预计 2028 年公布。Neptune 的 MAGNETO 机器人采用空化水射流清除船体污损，企业称可在 24 小时内清洁满载好望角型船、在 4 节水流中作业，且不损伤底层防污涂层并回收清除物；上述作业能力为企业自述，试验结果尚未产生。
entries.relevance_reason: 继 Cargill 之后第二家大型租船方加入 MPA 机器人清洗试验，船体清洗正从港口应急服务转向有数据回路的常态化管理，直接关系可清洗型防污体系的在役维护方式
entries.note: 待复核（短名单船体清洗兼容性表述；未改评级）
entries.title_en: Neptune Robotics partners with Louis Dreyfus to trial AI hull-cleaning robots in Singapore
entries.summary_en: Louis Dreyfus Company (LDC) and Neptune Robotics have entered a partnership to run robotic hull-cleaning trials under the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) innovation programme for underwater hull inspection and cleaning, lasting 18 months; LDC will open its fleet of more than 300 chartered vessels for in-service testing, evaluating the inspection and cleaning performance of the AI-driven robots and their impact on fuel consumption and emissions, with results expected in 2028. Neptune's MAGNETO robot uses cavitation water jets to remove hull fouling; the company states it can clean a fully laden Capesize vessel within 24 hours, operate in currents of 4 knots, and does not damage the underlying antifouling coating while recovering the removed material; the operating capabilities above are company-stated, and trial results have not yet been produced.
entries.relevance_reason_en: after Cargill, a second major charterer joins the MPA robotic cleaning trials; hull cleaning is shifting from an emergency port service to routine management with a data loop, directly affecting how cleanable antifouling systems are maintained in service
entries.note_en: Pending review (shortlist wording on hull-cleaning compatibility; ratings unchanged)

entries.title: AkzoNobel 旗下 International 发布无杀生剂游艇防污漆 Micron ReGen
entries.summary: AkzoNobel 11 月 17 日在 METSTRADE 发布 International 品牌新品 Micron ReGen，称其为首款采用「表面更新技术」（Surface Renewal Technology）的游艇防污漆：微孔表层兼具亲水与疏水特性，浸水后持续更新表面以阻碍附着，无需杀生剂。企业称三季实船试验显示节油 4.7%、等功率下航速提升 1.7%（企业自述试验数据，未见独立验证）；可直接刷涂/辊涂于状况良好的旧防污漆之上（PTFE 类除外），无需底漆或连接漆，当天施工当天可下水；首批在英国、爱尔兰、挪威、丹麦、芬兰、瑞典、荷兰、比利时、德国、奥地利、瑞士 11 个欧洲市场上市，共 5 色。
entries.relevance_reason: 无杀生剂路线出现面向游艇市场的可直接重涂新品，施工门槛明显低于既有无杀生剂体系；性能数字为企业自述，需独立数据支持
entries.note: 待复核（短名单无杀生剂路线与重涂兼容性表述；未改评级）
entries.title_en: AkzoNobel's International brand launches biocide-free yacht antifouling Micron ReGen
entries.summary_en: On 17 November at METSTRADE, AkzoNobel launched Micron ReGen under its International brand, described as the first yacht antifouling to use "Surface Renewal Technology": a microporous surface layer with both hydrophilic and hydrophobic character continuously renews the surface after immersion to hinder attachment, with no biocide required. The company states that three seasons of in-service trials showed fuel savings of 4.7% and a speed increase of 1.7% at equal power (company-stated trial data, with no independent verification seen); it can be brushed or rolled directly over old antifouling in good condition (except PTFE types), with no primer or tie coat needed, and the vessel can be launched the same day it is applied; it initially goes on sale in 11 European markets — the United Kingdom, Ireland, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Sweden, the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Austria and Switzerland — in a total of 5 colours.
entries.relevance_reason_en: the biocide-free route gains a directly recoatable new product aimed at the yacht market, with an application threshold clearly lower than that of existing biocide-free systems; the performance figures are company-stated and need independent data support
entries.note_en: Pending review (shortlist wording on biocide-free routes and recoat compatibility; ratings unchanged)

entries.title: 国内公开一种低迁移硅氧烷接枝丙烯酸防污涂料专利
entries.summary: 国家知识产权局 11 月 17 日公开一项防污涂料发明专利（申请人罗娟）：通过硅氢加成制备双端环氧硅氧烷并与氨基硅烷反应得到「自锚固硅氧烷」，再与丙烯酸酯共聚，得到硅氧烷接枝丙烯酸树脂；其设计目标是把硅氧烷链段化学锚定在树脂网络中，减少硅油向涂层表面迁移造成的低表面能衰减，同时以丙烯酸树脂提供附着力与机械强度。专利公开仅为技术方案披露，无实海防污验证数据。
entries.relevance_reason: 有机硅-丙烯酸杂化路线的国内专利动向，与低表面能防污配方思路相关，但仅为专利公开，无性能与实海证据
entries.title_en: Chinese patent published for a low-migration siloxane-grafted acrylic antifouling coating
entries.summary_en: On 17 November, the China National Intellectual Property Administration published an antifouling coating invention patent (applicant: Luo Juan): a di-epoxy-terminated siloxane is prepared by hydrosilylation and reacted with an aminosilane to obtain a "self-anchoring siloxane", which is then copolymerised with acrylates to give a siloxane-grafted acrylic resin; its design goal is to chemically anchor the siloxane segments within the resin network, reducing the loss of low surface energy caused by silicone oil migrating to the coating surface, while the acrylic resin provides adhesion and mechanical strength. A patent publication is only a disclosure of a technical solution, with no real-sea antifouling validation data.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a domestic patent development on the silicone–acrylic hybrid route, related to low-surface-energy antifouling formulation thinking, but it is only a patent publication, with no performance or real-sea evidence

entries.title: GIT 石墨烯污损释放涂层+船上机器人梳理完成一年实船运行
entries.summary: 11 月 15 日刊出的行业分析回顾了 GIT Coatings 披露的案例：一艘气体运输船采用石墨烯基污损释放涂层，配合船上机器人梳理系统连续商业运行满一年，期间完成 7 次水下检查与 3 次梳理；据 GIT 披露，出坞后动力性能较此前高级防污漆基线提升约 6%，全年附加功率增长控制在约 2% 以内（期间闲置超 180 天），每次梳理后恢复 3–5% 效率，全年未出现硬污损、涂层未见可测劣化。以上数字均为企业方披露的单船案例，未经独立第三方验证；底层案例研究曾于 2026 年初 HullPIC 会议报告。BW Epic Kosan 已在多艘 LPG 船上扩大采用该体系。
entries.relevance_reason: 无杀生剂涂层+主动梳理的「持续船体管理」模式出现首个完整年度实船数据，但为单船、企业自述口径，需多船多年数据与独立验证方可作为选型依据
entries.title_en: GIT graphene foul-release coating + onboard robotic grooming completes one year of in-service operation
entries.summary_en: An industry analysis published on 15 November reviewed a case disclosed by GIT Coatings: a gas carrier using a graphene-based foul-release coating, together with an onboard robotic grooming system, completed a full year of continuous commercial operation, during which 7 underwater inspections and 3 grooming sessions were carried out; according to GIT's disclosure, power performance after dry-docking improved by about 6% against the previous premium antifouling baseline, added power growth over the year was kept within about 2% (including more than 180 days idle), each grooming session restored 3–5% efficiency, and no hard fouling appeared over the year and the coating showed no measurable degradation. All of these figures are from a single-vessel case disclosed by the company and have not been independently verified by a third party; the underlying case study was reported at the HullPIC conference in early 2026. BW Epic Kosan has expanded its adoption of the system across multiple LPG carriers.
entries.relevance_reason_en: the "continuous hull management" model of biocide-free coating + active grooming now has its first full year of in-service data, but it is a single vessel with company-stated figures, and multi-vessel, multi-year data with independent verification is needed before it can serve as a basis for selection

entries.title: Hempel 携 Hempaguard X7 亮相 METSTRADE，附独立生命周期评估数据
entries.summary: 11 月 17–19 日阿姆斯特丹 METSTRADE 展会上，Hempel 将 Hempaguard X7 列入超级游艇可持续路线（展位 02.423），并引用 Water Revolution Foundation 的对比生命周期评估：与传统 Hempel Mille NCT 71880 方案相比，端点级环境影响改善 31.5%（该数值为该评估特定假设下的聚合指标，并非节油率，不可直接解读为燃油节省）。Hempaguard X7 本身并非新品（Hempel 于 2013 年推出），为硅酮水凝胶表面+防污杀生剂的混合体系，并非无杀生剂涂层；其卖点是面向长期停泊的超级游艇工况的独立评估证据。
entries.relevance_reason: 无杀生剂/低影响路线的生命周期证据进入游艇选型讨论，但产品本身含杀生剂且非新品，31.5% 为评估口径而非实测节油
entries.title_en: Hempel showcases Hempaguard X7 at METSTRADE, with independent life-cycle assessment data
entries.summary_en: At the METSTRADE show in Amsterdam on 17–19 November, Hempel included Hempaguard X7 in its superyacht sustainability route (booth 02.423) and cited a comparative life-cycle assessment by the Water Revolution Foundation: compared with the conventional Hempel Mille NCT 71880 scheme, endpoint-level environmental impact improved by 31.5% (this figure is an aggregated indicator under the specific assumptions of that assessment, not a fuel-saving rate, and cannot be read directly as fuel savings). Hempaguard X7 is not itself a new product (Hempel launched it in 2013); it is a hybrid system of a silicone hydrogel surface plus an antifouling biocide, not a biocide-free coating; its selling point is the independent assessment evidence for superyacht duty involving long idle periods.
entries.relevance_reason_en: life-cycle evidence for biocide-free / low-impact routes is entering yacht selection discussions, but the product itself contains a biocide and is not new, and the 31.5% is an assessment figure rather than measured fuel savings

weeks.trend_summary_en: This week's theme is "biocide-free routes accelerating into products, biocide-containing routes accelerating into restriction": at METSTRADE, AkzoNobel launched Micron ReGen, a directly recoatable biocide-free yacht paint; Hempel backed an existing hybrid system with an independent life-cycle assessment; and GIT's graphene coating + robotic grooming produced a full year of in-service data — three lines that together point to hull performance management that does not rely on biocides moving from concept towards purchasable, applicable products and services. Meanwhile, the EU formally closed the medetomidine renewal with Decision (EU) 2026/2567 and set a market-exit line of 8 June 2027, in contrast with New Zealand's consultation in the previous issue: the access map for the same active substance is differentiating by jurisdiction. At the regulatory level, the nine shipping associations jointly called for global carbon rules, and with MEPC 85 and the resumed-session vote on 4 December approaching, every increment of hull resistance may translate directly into compliance cost — the shared economic backdrop for efficient antifouling and active hull management alike. On the domestic patent front, incremental routes such as silicone hybrids still predominate, with no comparable real-sea-level breakthrough seen.

entries.title: 高岭土增强超疏水环氧防腐涂层论文刊出
entries.summary: Coatings 2026 年 11 月刊（16 卷 11 期，文章号 1339）刊出三层超疏水防腐涂层研究：高岭土增强环氧底漆+弹性胶黏中间层+疏水 SiO₂ 面层，水接触角 157.8°、滚动角 2.1°；19 m 磨耗或 200 次胶带剥离后仍保持超疏水；3.5% NaCl 中腐蚀电流密度降至 7.9×10⁻¹² A·cm⁻²，浸泡 15 天防护效率约 99.33%；盐雾、浸泡、户外、紫外老化及防污自清洁试验中结构完整；防污仅为实验室自清洁定性试验，未做实海防污验证。
entries.relevance_reason: 防腐与自清洁界面设计为主，防污证据仅限实验室定性试验，与船体防污配方选型间接相关
entries.title_en: Paper on a kaolin-reinforced superhydrophobic epoxy anticorrosion coating published
entries.summary_en: The November 2026 issue of Coatings (vol. 16, issue 11, article 1339) published a study of a three-layer superhydrophobic anticorrosion coating: a kaolin-reinforced epoxy primer + elastic adhesive interlayer + hydrophobic SiO₂ topcoat, with a water contact angle of 157.8° and a sliding angle of 2.1°; superhydrophobicity was retained after 19 m of abrasion or 200 tape-peeling cycles; in 3.5% NaCl, the corrosion current density fell to 7.9×10⁻¹² A·cm⁻², with a protection efficiency of about 99.33% after 15 days of immersion; the structure remained intact through salt-spray, immersion, outdoor and UV-ageing tests and antifouling self-cleaning tests; the antifouling evidence was only a qualitative laboratory self-cleaning test, with no real-sea antifouling validation.
entries.relevance_reason_en: mainly anticorrosion and self-cleaning interface design; the antifouling evidence is limited to qualitative laboratory tests, indirectly related to hull antifouling formulation selection

entries.title: 新西兰 EPA 就 Selektope 进口与含 Selektope 游艇漆启动公众咨询
entries.summary: 新西兰环保局（EPA）11 月 5 日就两项申请启动公众咨询，12 月 17 日截止：I-Tech 申请进口或生产 Selektope（medetomidine）新活性物（APP204449），Altex Coatings 申请含该活性物的 Altex Ablative Antifoul (TFS) 系列防污漆（APP204450）；若获批，Selektope 仅限专业人员在商业场景下用于生产防污漆，成品漆拟面向专业与非专业用户；EPA 将评估人体健康与新西兰环境风险与收益。这是欧盟成员国 11 月 3 日投票支持不予续批后，Selektope 在另一司法辖区的准入进展。
entries.relevance_reason: Selektope 欧盟受挫后在新西兰的准入风向，直接影响含该活性物产品的区域市场预期
entries.note: 待复核（短名单含 Selektope 产品的区域准入表述；未改评级）
entries.title_en: New Zealand EPA opens public consultation on Selektope imports and Selektope-containing yacht paint
entries.summary_en: On 5 November, the New Zealand Environmental Protection Authority (EPA) opened public consultations on two applications, closing on 17 December: I-Tech's application to import or manufacture the new active substance Selektope (medetomidine) (APP204449), and Altex Coatings' application for its Altex Ablative Antifoul (TFS) range of antifouling paints containing that substance (APP204450). If approved, Selektope would be limited to professional use in commercial settings for manufacturing antifouling paint, while the finished paints are intended for both professional and non-professional users; the EPA will assess the human-health and New Zealand environmental risks and benefits. This is Selektope's market-access progress in another jurisdiction after EU member states voted on 3 November to support non-renewal.
entries.relevance_reason_en: the direction of Selektope access in New Zealand after its setback in the EU directly affects regional market expectations for products containing this active substance
entries.note_en: Pending review (regional market-access wording for Selektope-containing products on the shortlist; ratings unchanged)

entries.title: 广船国际发布全球首创双高脉冲激光清洗设备
entries.summary: 11 月 5 日，中船广船国际联合齐鲁中科光物理与工程技术研究院、北京新双高科技在南沙发布新一代双高纳秒脉冲激光清洗设备；其中 3kW、4kW 单腔单模机型为全球首创，填补国内船舶修造高效智能脉冲激光清洗装备空白；现场演示 4000W 高功率爬壁机器人激光清洗系统；企业称设备粉尘少、噪音低、智能化水平高；广船国际还牵头推动《船舶涂装前激光清洗技术要求》团体标准出台。
entries.relevance_reason: 涂装前表面处理自动化新装备，涉及除锈效率与涂层附着基础，但属前处理环节而非防污配方本身
entries.title_en: GSI releases world-first dual high-pulse laser cleaning equipment
entries.summary_en: On 5 November, CSSC Guangzhou Shipyard International (GSI), together with the Qilu Zhongke Institute of Optical Physics and Engineering Technology and Beijing Xinshuanggao Technology, released in Nansha a new generation of dual high-nanosecond pulsed laser cleaning equipment; the 3 kW and 4 kW single-cavity single-mode models are world firsts, filling a domestic gap in efficient, intelligent pulsed laser cleaning equipment for ship repair and building; a 4,000 W high-power wall-climbing robot laser cleaning system was demonstrated on site; the company states the equipment produces little dust and low noise and is highly intelligent; GSI is also leading the development of a group standard, "Technical Requirements for Laser Cleaning Before Ship Coating".
entries.relevance_reason_en: new automation equipment for pre-coating surface preparation, concerning rust-removal efficiency and the basis for coating adhesion, but it belongs to the pre-treatment stage rather than to antifouling formulation itself

entries.title: 牡蛎壳生物基双温防污涂层论文刊出
entries.summary: Coatings 2026 年 11 月刊（16 卷 11 期，文章号 1304）刊出台湾团队研究：600°C 煅烧牡蛎壳粉（占干固体 15 wt%）与 AZO@SiO₂ 核壳纳米粒复配的水性丙烯酸涂层；安平港 12 个月实海挂板可见大污损明显低于空白对照，但局部仍有沉积；实验室光照 100 W/m² 下涂层表面 90 秒升至 42.1±1.8°C（对照 31.2±0.8°C）；28 天浸出试验 Cu、Zn、Sn、Fe 均低于检出限；挥发性胺驱避与光热防污机制仍为假说，作者明确未做受控附着生物学验证。
entries.relevance_reason: 废弃物 valorization 的无铜水性防污思路，可对照无杀生剂配方路线；机制未验证、实海效果有限是重要限定
entries.title_en: Paper on an oyster-shell bio-based dual-temperature antifouling coating published
entries.summary_en: The November 2026 issue of Coatings (vol. 16, issue 11, article 1304) published a study by a Taiwanese team: a waterborne acrylic coating combining oyster shell powder calcined at 600 °C (15 wt% of dry solids) with AZO@SiO₂ core–shell nanoparticles; in 12-month real-sea panel immersion at Anping Port, macrofouling was visibly lower than on the blank control, though local deposition remained; under 100 W/m² laboratory illumination, the coating surface rose to 42.1±1.8 °C within 90 seconds (control 31.2±0.8 °C); in a 28-day leaching test, Cu, Zn, Sn and Fe were all below detection limits; the volatile-amine repellence and photothermal antifouling mechanisms remain hypotheses, and the authors explicitly did not carry out controlled attachment-biology validation.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a copper-free waterborne antifouling idea based on waste valorisation, benchmarkable against biocide-free formulation routes; the unverified mechanism and limited real-sea effect are important caveats

entries.title: Jotun 公布 PortPIC 2026 研究的 DNV 验证数据
entries.summary: Jotun 11 月 2 日发布 PortPIC 2026 研究的验证数据口径（底层文章 10 月 26 日刊出，上期已收录）：DNV 基于 ISO 19030 方法与实船运行数据，对 33 艘采用 Hull Skating Solutions 的船舶验证平均 3.5 年无可测速损、船体始终洁净；其中一艘大型集装箱船年减 CO₂ 17.7%、约 17,300 吨；第二项研究显示海底门（sea chest）受控表面处理与施工可改善防污性能；研究同时核算了涂层、机器人与船上站点的自身足迹，结论为净气候收益为正。以上减排数字为企业与 DNV 验证口径，非本模拟器实测。
entries.relevance_reason: DNV 第三方验证的整船级主动清洗+涂层数据，直接关系可清洗型防污体系与船体性能选型
entries.note: 待复核（短名单 Jotun SeaQuantum 等与 Hull Skating 兼容体系叙事；未改评级）
entries.title_en: Jotun publishes DNV-verified data from its PortPIC 2026 study
entries.summary_en: On 2 November, Jotun released the verified-data basis of its PortPIC 2026 study (the underlying article was published on 26 October and was covered in the previous issue): based on the ISO 19030 method and real-ship operating data, DNV verified, across 33 vessels using Hull Skating Solutions, an average of 3.5 years with no measurable speed loss and hulls kept always clean; one large container ship cut CO₂ by 17.7% per year, about 17,300 tonnes. A second study showed that controlled surface treatment and application of sea chests can improve antifouling performance. The study also accounted for the footprint of the coating, the robot and the onboard station itself, concluding that the net climate benefit is positive. The emission-reduction figures above are company figures on a DNV verification basis, not measurements made by this simulator.
entries.relevance_reason_en: DNV third-party-verified, whole-ship-level data on active cleaning + coating directly affects the selection of cleanable antifouling systems and hull performance
entries.note_en: Pending review (shortlist narrative on Hull Skating-compatible systems such as Jotun SeaQuantum; ratings unchanged)

weeks.coverage_en: 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-16 (Beijing time; mainly the last 7 days, with international product/company news slightly widened to 14 days)

weeks.trend_summary_en: This week, Selektope access diverged: after EU member states voted to support non-renewal, New Zealand's EPA promptly opened a public consultation on the substance and on yacht paints containing it, making the direction of regional access a key variable for biocide-containing routes. On the copper-free side, the papers on the oyster-shell bio-based coating and the kaolin superhydrophobic coating both offered laboratory highlights alongside explicit caveats at the real-sea and mechanism levels, a reminder that formulation selection should still be governed by real-sea evidence. On the supply side, coating automation landed in a concentrated way across domestic shipyards — laser cleaning equipment released, four-robot linked painting, electrostatic spraying entering dry-dock repair — which, together with Jotun's DNV-verified data, pushes "verifiable hull performance" to the fore; leading manufacturers' group results continued to grow, and domestic package orders expanded in step.

entries.title: 美国南加州 SCAQMD 拟修 Rule 1106 收紧船舶涂料 VOC 与硅氧烷
entries.summary: 南加州空气质量管理区（South Coast AQMD）就修订船舶与游艇涂料规则 Rule 1106 提交 CEQA 豁免公告：拟分阶段禁用含对氯三氟甲苯（pCBtF）、叔丁基乙酸酯（t-BAc）超痕量的涂料，并禁止销售使用含完全甲基化硅氧烷超痕量的涂料，另设 VOC 限值与记录标签要求；预计每日减排 VOC 23.9 磅。
entries.relevance_reason: 甲基化硅氧烷限用直接触及有机硅污损释放涂料配方，VOC 收紧影响溶剂型体系
entries.title_en: Southern California SCAQMD proposes amending Rule 1106 to tighten VOC and siloxanes in marine coatings
entries.summary_en: The South Coast Air Quality Management District (SCAQMD) in Southern California has issued a CEQA exemption notice for amending Rule 1106 on marine and pleasure-craft coatings: it proposes phasing out coatings containing more than trace amounts of parachlorobenzotrifluoride (pCBtF) and tert-butyl acetate (t-BAc), prohibiting the sale and use of coatings containing more than trace amounts of fully methylated siloxanes, and adding VOC limits together with record-keeping and labelling requirements; the expected reduction is 23.9 pounds of VOC per day.
entries.relevance_reason_en: methylated-siloxane restrictions directly touch silicone foul-release coating formulations, and tighter VOC rules affect solvent-borne systems

entries.title_en: EU member states support non-renewal of the Selektope (medetomidine) approval
entries.summary_en: EU member states voted to support the European Commission's proposal not to renew the approval of Selektope (active substance medetomidine) as a PT21 antifouling biocide; once the formal decision is published, a transition period of about 180 days is expected, during which Selektope-containing coatings may still be supplied and applied in the EU, after which they may no longer be placed on the EU market; vessels already coated are unaffected. entries.title: 生物基两亲聚合物防污涂层论文刊出
entries.summary: Marine Pollution Bulletin 2026 年 11 月刊（232 卷，文章号 120083）刊出生物基两亲聚合物防污涂层研究：以可再生平台化学品经避免使用有害溶剂的自由基聚合制备涂层，调节亲疏水平衡；实验室试验中疏水为主配方对硅藻附着抑制超 90%，对卤虫无可检出急性毒性；但静态实海挂板中两亲配方未能阻止污损累积，提示仍需优化。刊期仅知 2026 年 11 月，精确上线日未公布。

entries.title_en: Paper on a bio-based amphiphilic polymer antifouling coating published
entries.summary_en: The November 2026 issue of Marine Pollution Bulletin (vol. 232, article 120083) published a study of a bio-based amphiphilic polymer antifouling coating: the coating was prepared from renewable platform chemicals by free-radical polymerisation that avoids harmful solvents, tuning the hydrophilic/hydrophobic balance; in laboratory tests, the hydrophobe-dominant formulation inhibited diatom attachment by more than 90% and showed no detectable acute toxicity to Artemia; however, in static real-sea panel immersion the amphiphilic formulations failed to prevent fouling accumulation, indicating that further optimisation is still needed. Only the publication month (November 2026) is known; the exact online date has not been announced.
entries.relevance_reason_en: design ideas for copper-free bio-based antifouling binders, benchmarkable against biocide-free formulation routes; the shortfall in real-sea performance is an important caveat

weeks.trend_summary_en: Robotic cleaning has entered the real-ship validation stage with major shipowners: the Cargill–Neptune Singapore trial ties cleaning efficiency, coating compatibility and measured fuel savings together. The EU non-renewal of Selektope and California's siloxane restrictions tighten, on two fronts, the compliance space for biocide-containing and silicone routes; the copper-free bio-based coating paper shows there is still a gap between laboratory algae inhibition and real-sea performance. Leading manufacturers' marine coating volumes continue to grow and domestic package certifications expand — the next stage will look more at measured cleaning data, regional market-access changes for products containing active substances, and real-sea evidence for copper-free formulations.

weeks.trend_summary_en: IMO convention discussion is shifting from "whether to capture" to "how to measure and how to prove it", and China is likewise developing a group standard for accelerated assessment methods for long-life antifouling coatings. entries.title_en: Sunrui silicone antifouling paint completes the National Day drydock application on the "Huahaihang 3"
entries.summary_en: The product relies mainly on low surface energy for physical antifouling; reports say it can save about 5%–12% of fuel over the full life cycle and cut overall coating cost by about 30%–40%; the figures are as reported in the coverage and have not been independently verified.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a domestic silicone foul-release case on a real vessel

entries.title: UCIBIO：marinone 类天然产物无杀生剂涂层减少贻贝附着
entries.summary: PTM-346 粗提物加入无杀生剂涂层后，三种配方的贻贝附着减少约 22%–33%，10 天暴露后贻贝全部存活；静态条件下抗生物膜效果有限，需要更长期的动态和实海试验。
entries.relevance_reason: 天然防污剂入配方，对大型污损有效但抗生物膜不足
entries.title_en: UCIBIO: marinone-type natural-product biocide-free coating reduces mussel settlement
entries.summary_en: After the crude extract PTM-346 was added to a biocide-free coating, mussel settlement fell by about 22%–33% across three formulations, and all mussels survived 10 days of exposure; antibiofilm performance under static conditions was limited, and longer dynamic and real-sea trials are needed.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a natural antifoulant in a formulation; effective against macrofouling but insufficient against biofilm

entries.title: 新西兰 MPI 委托 LWP 调研船东对无杀生剂防污的看法
entries.summary: Land Water People 受 MPI 委托开展匿名问卷，内容涉及效果、成本、维护、清洗习惯和采用障碍，用于评估国内船队转向无杀生剂防污的可行性。
entries.relevance_reason: 可能影响新西兰对无杀生剂涂层的政策取向
entries.title_en: New Zealand MPI commissions LWP to survey shipowners' views on biocide-free antifouling
entries.summary_en: Land Water People is running an anonymous questionnaire commissioned by MPI, covering effectiveness, cost, maintenance, cleaning habits and barriers to adoption, to assess the feasibility of the domestic fleet switching to biocide-free antifouling.
entries.relevance_reason_en: could influence New Zealand's policy stance toward biocide-free coatings

entries.title: Biofouling：佛罗里达东海岸两处挂板站评估 UV-C 与涂层联用的防污效果
entries.summary: Florida Institute of Technology 腐蚀与生物污损控制中心（Yeshi、Hunsucker 等）比较 UV-C 与船舶涂层联用的防污效果（信息来自 Crossref 元数据，期刊全文未打开）。
entries.relevance_reason: UV-C 辅助可降低对涂层杀生剂的依赖，与 UV-C 方向相关
entries.title_en: Biofouling: two panel stations on Florida's east coast evaluate the antifouling performance of UV-C combined with coatings
entries.summary_en: The Center for Corrosion and Biofouling Control at Florida Institute of Technology (Yeshi, Hunsucker et al.) compared the antifouling performance of UV-C combined with ship coatings (information from Crossref metadata; the full journal text was not opened).
entries.relevance_reason_en: UV-C assistance can reduce reliance on coating biocides; relevant to the UV-C direction

weeks.trend_summary: IMO 公约谈判进入细节，BIMCO 赶在 10 月 24 日前收集一线证据，弗里曼特尔的受控清洗模式受到关注。技术上硅基污损释放和两亲添加剂继续升温，国产涂料企业则在用认证和渠道争取市场准入。

entries.title: 哈工程等：有机硅防污涂层两亲添加剂存在"临界添加量窗口"
entries.summary: 两亲添加剂 PFV 能向表面偏析并共价锚定，添加量在 10–30 wt%、最佳约 20 wt% 时，细菌和硅藻附着抑制率超过 90%，不使用传统杀生剂。
entries.relevance_reason: 直接给出硅基 FRC 配方中两亲添加剂的用量窗口
entries.title_en: Harbin Engineering University and others: amphiphilic additives in silicone antifouling coatings have a "critical dosage window"
entries.summary_en: The amphiphilic additive PFV segregates to the surface and anchors covalently; at dosages of 10–30 wt%, with an optimum around 20 wt%, inhibition of bacterial and diatom attachment exceeded 90%, without conventional biocides.
entries.relevance_reason_en: directly gives the dosage window for amphiphilic additives in silicone FRC formulations

entries.title: BIMCO 提醒：三项生物污损调研 10 月 24 日截止
entries.summary: BIMCO 再次呼吁船东、运营方提供检查、清洗、涂层和服务可得性方面的实际经验，为 IMO 公约中的强制评估、阈值触发清洗、认证和执法条款谈判提供依据。
entries.relevance_reason: 公约条款将直接约束涂层与清洗方案
entries.title_en: BIMCO reminder: three biofouling surveys close on October 24
entries.summary_en: BIMCO again called on shipowners and operators to provide practical experience on inspection, cleaning, coatings and service availability, to inform negotiations on mandatory assessment, threshold-triggered cleaning, certification and enforcement provisions in the IMO convention.
entries.relevance_reason_en: convention provisions will directly constrain coating and cleaning options

entries.title: 弗里曼特尔港水下清洗试点满半年，被视为可复制模板
entries.summary: 澳大利亚首个允许在港内对商船受控水下清洗的安排，清洗前评估入侵物种和涂层化学风险，清洗物经捕集、10 μm 过滤和 UV 处理后排放；试点为期三年并逐年复核。
entries.relevance_reason: 澳洲航线可清洗性与涂层化学风险评估相关
entries.title_en: Fremantle Port in-water cleaning pilot passes six months and is seen as a replicable template
entries.summary_en: Australia's first arrangement permitting controlled in-water cleaning of commercial vessels in port; before cleaning, invasive-species and coating-chemistry risks are assessed, and the wash water is captured, filtered to 10 μm and UV-treated before discharge; the pilot runs for three years with annual reviews.
entries.relevance_reason_en: relevant to cleanability on Australian routes and to coating-chemistry risk assessment

entries.title: PPG 和 Jotun 谈船体涂层、能效与无杀生剂污损释放
entries.summary: 两家都把污损和粗糙度视为影响能耗和排放的关键；Jotun 强调按航线定制并用 ISO 19030 评估，PPG 介绍纯有机硅 SIGMAGLIDE 2390 和坞修静电喷涂（ESTA）。
entries.relevance_reason: 污损释放涂层选型与施工工艺参考
entries.title_en: PPG and Jotun on hull coatings, energy efficiency and biocide-free foul release
entries.summary_en: Both companies treat fouling and roughness as key factors affecting energy consumption and emissions; Jotun emphasises tailoring to the route and assessment under ISO 19030, while PPG introduced its pure-silicone SIGMAGLIDE 2390 and electrostatic spray application in drydock (ESTA).
entries.relevance_reason_en: reference for foul-release coating selection and application processes

entries.title: 慧正资讯：9 月国产船舶涂料靠认证和渠道争取准入
entries.summary: 北新大桥 9 月 16 日在南通召开船舶海工涂料招商会，立邦参与中船物资供应链对接，信和新材料与泉州船东协会签署战略协作；麦加芯彩、德威等获 CCS 认证。
entries.relevance_reason: 市场准入动态，对配方选型为背景信息
entries.title_en: Huizheng Info: in September, domestic marine coatings chase market access through certification and channels
entries.summary_en: Beixin Daqiao held a marine and offshore coatings distributor meeting in Nantong on September 16, Nippon Paint took part in supply-chain matchmaking with CSSC's materials arm, and Xinhe New Materials signed a strategic cooperation with the Quanzhou Shipowners' Association; Maijia Xincai, Dewei and others obtained CCS certification.
entries.relevance_reason_en: market-access developments; background information for formulation selection

weeks.title: 行业进展｜2026-09-21
weeks.nature: 行业动态/公开资料，非性能数据。回溯补录，均已在原始来源核对日期与内容。
weeks.trend_summary: 本周材料偏少。实海对比证据进一步支持硅基无杀生剂和降铜配方。海湾长期锚泊船舶复航时的污损问题仍是航运端关心的风险。

entries.title: 瑞典 Chalmers 研究：无杀生剂硅基防污漆在游艇试验中表现最好
entries.summary: 研究在瑞典、丹麦、法国沿海比较七种防污漆，无杀生剂硅基漆效果最好；标榜环保的含 tralopyril 产品毒性极高；低铜含量漆可以和高铜漆一样有效。
entries.relevance_reason: 直接支持降铜和硅基无杀生剂配方选择
entries.title_en: Chalmers study in Sweden: biocide-free silicone antifouling paint performs best in yacht trials
entries.summary_en: The study compared seven antifouling paints on the coasts of Sweden, Denmark and France, and the biocide-free silicone paint performed best; a product marketed as eco-friendly that contains tralopyril proved highly toxic; low-copper paints can be as effective as high-copper paints.
entries.relevance_reason_en: directly supports copper reduction and silicone biocide-free formulation choices

entries.title: ACS AMI：仿非洲爪蟾电活性表皮的压电防污涂层
entries.summary: 华南理工等团队把石墨烯增强 PVDF 压电基体与 ZIF-8 包封的光响应 NO 供体结合，在水流机械刺激下重新分布表面电荷促进污损脱附，同时可控释放 NO（据 Crossref 摘要）。
entries.relevance_reason: 压电+可控释放的多机制设计，仍属实验室阶段
entries.title_en: ACS AMI: piezoelectric antifouling coating inspired by the electroactive skin of the African clawed frog
entries.summary_en: A team including South China University of Technology combined a graphene-enhanced PVDF piezoelectric matrix with a ZIF-8-encapsulated, photoresponsive NO donor; under mechanical stimulation from water flow it redistributes surface charge to promote fouling detachment, while releasing NO in a controlled manner (per the Crossref abstract).
entries.relevance_reason_en: a multi-mechanism piezoelectric + controlled-release design, still at the laboratory stage

entries.title: 海湾危机持续，锚泊船舶生物污损风险叠加
entries.summary: 文章引用 AIS 数据：截至 2026 年 6 月中旬海湾滞留船舶 958 艘，其中 63% 已闲置 100 天以上；长期闲置会改变船体状况，带来航速、油耗、排放和生物安全上的后续影响。
entries.relevance_reason: 长期锚泊后复航的涂层表现与清洗决策
entries.title_en: Gulf crisis continues: biofouling risks multiply for ships at anchor
entries.summary_en: The article cites AIS data: as of mid-June 2026, 958 vessels were stranded in the Gulf, 63% of them idle for more than 100 days; prolonged idling changes hull condition, with knock-on effects on speed, fuel consumption, emissions and biosecurity.
entries.relevance_reason_en: coating performance and cleaning decisions when vessels return to service after long anchorage

weeks.trend_summary_en: Material was thinner this week. Real-sea comparative evidence further supports silicone biocide-free and reduced-copper formulations. Fouling on Gulf vessels returning to service after long anchorage remains a risk the shipping side is watching.

weeks.trend_summary: 本周头部船东与海虹老人签下长期有机硅协议，污损释放涂层在大型集装箱船队的地位进一步巩固。SMM 新品集中在无杀生剂、低 VOC 和数字化选漆。研究端在用 CeO₂ 等共杀生剂减少铜用量。

entries.title: PLOS ONE：微图案聚合物上的 ZnO 纳米棒防污涂层
entries.summary: 苏丹卡布斯大学团队把 ZnO 纳米棒做在三种微图案聚合物表面，接触角约 150–165°，实验室流动条件下降低大肠杆菌和双眉藻附着，并用白对虾幼体评估急性毒性；仍需实海试验。
entries.relevance_reason: 微纳结构+无机纳米材料的低毒防污思路
entries.title_en: PLOS ONE: ZnO nanorod antifouling coating on micropatterned polymers
entries.summary_en: A team at Sultan Qaboos University grew ZnO nanorods on three micropatterned polymer surfaces, achieving contact angles of about 150–165°; under laboratory flow conditions the coating reduced attachment of E. coli and Amphora diatoms, and acute toxicity was assessed using whiteleg shrimp larvae; sea trials are still needed.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a low-toxicity antifouling approach combining micro/nano structure with inorganic nanomaterials

entries.title: 慧正资讯盘点 SMM 2026 船舶涂料新品
entries.summary: 汉堡 SMM（9 月 1–4 日）上：佐敦展示 HSS，立邦推广低 VOC 无杀生剂 AQUATERRAS 1100，海虹老人推出可在合拢阶段施工、耐 6 个月露天舾装的 Hempaguard NB，中涂化工展示基于 ISO 19030 的 CMP-MAP 选漆工具。
entries.relevance_reason: 新造船有机硅施工窗口、按 AIS 运营剖面推荐防污漆等选型工具值得关注
entries.title_en: Huizheng Info rounds up the new marine coating products at SMM 2026
entries.summary_en: At SMM in Hamburg (September 1–4): Jotun showcased HSS, Nippon Paint promoted its low-VOC, biocide-free AQUATERRAS 1100, Hempel launched Hempaguard NB, which can be applied at the block-assembly stage and withstand six months of outdoor outfitting, and Chugoku Marine Paints presented its CMP-MAP paint-selection tool based on ISO 19030.
entries.relevance_reason_en: the silicone application window for newbuildings, and tools that recommend antifouling paints by AIS operating profile, are worth watching

entries.title: 氧化铈纳米颗粒作为无毒共杀生剂改善自抛光防污漆
entries.summary: 在 SPA 配方中加入 0.1–0.5 wt% CeO₂，抗菌活性、表面亲水性和铜释放都有改善，有望减少铜用量。
entries.relevance_reason: 直接涉及铜系 SPC 配方的共杀生剂选择与添加量
entries.title_en: Cerium oxide nanoparticles as a non-toxic co-biocide improve self-polishing antifouling paints
entries.summary_en: Adding 0.1–0.5 wt% CeO₂ to an SPC formulation improved antibacterial activity, surface hydrophilicity and copper release, with the potential to reduce copper use.
entries.relevance_reason_en: directly concerns co-biocide choice and dosage in copper-based SPC formulations

entries.title: 海虹老人与马士基签署三年全球船体涂料协议
entries.summary: 协议覆盖马士基 2026–2028 年大部分坞修；Hempaguard 有机硅系列自 2013 年以来已涂装 6000 多次，海虹老人按 DNV 验证方法估算累计避免约 4340 万吨 CO₂。
entries.relevance_reason: 头部集装箱船队选择有机硅污损释放，影响同类航线选型
entries.title_en: Hempel signs three-year global hull coatings agreement with Maersk
entries.summary_en: The agreement covers most of Maersk's drydockings in 2026–2028; the Hempaguard silicone range has been applied more than 6,000 times since 2013, and Hempel estimates, using a DNV-verified method, cumulative avoided CO₂ emissions of about 43.4 million tonnes.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a leading container fleet choosing silicone foul-release affects coating selection on similar routes

New products at SMM centred on biocide-free, low-VOC and digital paint selection. On the research side, co-biocides such as CeO₂ are being used to reduce copper use.

entries.title: SAFETY4SEA 专访佐敦：船体性能是降低排放最容易摘的果实
entries.summary: 佐敦强调按船舶贸易和运营剖面、污损压力定制涂层规格，用数字化和大数据评估性能，并指出施工质量对最终表现同样关键。
entries.relevance_reason: "按航线定制"直接对应航线选型逻辑
entries.title_en: SAFETY4SEA interview with Jotun: hull performance is the lowest-hanging fruit for cutting emissions
entries.summary_en: Jotun emphasised tailoring coating specifications to the vessel's trade and operating profile and fouling pressure, using digitalisation and big data to assess performance, and noted that application quality is equally critical to the final result.
entries.relevance_reason_en: "tailoring by route" corresponds directly to route-based selection logic

entries.title: 德威涂料完成"大和谐号"甲板货船坞修涂装
entries.summary: 22578.6 DWT 远洋甲板货船总施工面积 7680 m²，覆盖船壳外板和压载舱，水下部位采用德威无锡自抛光防污漆。
entries.relevance_reason: 常规无锡 SPC 坞修案例
entries.title_en: Dewei Coatings completes dry-dock coating on the deck cargo ship "Dahexie"
entries.summary_en: The 22,578.6 DWT ocean-going deck cargo ship had a total application area of 7,680 m², covering the shell plating and ballast tanks, with Dewei tin-free self-polishing antifouling paint used on the underwater parts.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a routine tin-free SPC dry-dock case

entries.title: 佐敦：Imperial 游艇防污体系 30 年碳足迹约低 50%
entries.summary: Imperial 采用硅烷丙烯酸自抛光技术，可按航行模式和锚泊时间定制配套；佐敦分析称它通过减少维护次数、用漆量和废弃物，30 年服役期碳足迹比常规防污体系低约 50%。
entries.relevance_reason: 低速/长锚泊工况的硅烷丙烯酸 SPC 定制案例
entries.title_en: Jotun: Imperial yacht antifouling system has roughly 50% lower carbon footprint over 30 years
entries.summary_en: Imperial uses silane-acrylic self-polishing technology and can be tailored to sailing patterns and anchoring time; Jotun's analysis says that by reducing maintenance frequency, paint consumption and waste, its carbon footprint over a 30-year service life is about 50% lower than conventional antifouling systems.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a silane-acrylic SPC tailoring case for low-speed / long-anchorage conditions

entries.title: 世航智能海洋机器人用于船体清洗，230 m 船约 10 小时完成
entries.summary: 据中国经营报，山东诚裕船务称人工清洗一艘 230 m 船需要 24–72 小时，机器人约 10 小时，清除率 85% 以上；世航智能今年 6 月完成超 10 亿元 A 轮融资。
entries.relevance_reason: 清洗服务经济性，间接影响配方耐清洗要求
entries.title_en: Shihang Intelligent marine robot used for hull cleaning, finishing a 230 m ship in about 10 hours
entries.summary_en: According to China Business Journal, Shandong Chengyu Shipping said manual cleaning of a 230 m ship takes 24–72 hours while the robot takes about 10 hours, with a removal rate above 85%; Shihang Intelligent completed a Series A round of over RMB 1 billion in June this year.
entries.relevance_reason_en: cleaning-service economics, indirectly affecting formulation wash-resistance requirements

entries.title: BIMCO 发起调研，收集 IMO 2023 生物污损指南的实施经验
entries.summary: IMO 正在考虑具有法律约束力的"生物污损公约"，BIMCO 预计可能在 2029 年通过；调研收集指南实施、有效性和操作挑战的反馈，同时还面向港口代理和服务商开展调研。
entries.relevance_reason: 强制公约将直接影响涂层与清洗方案的合规选型
entries.title_en: BIMCO launches survey to gather implementation experience with the IMO 2023 biofouling guidelines
entries.summary_en: The IMO is considering a legally binding "biofouling convention", which BIMCO expects could be adopted in 2029; the survey gathers feedback on guideline implementation, effectiveness and operational challenges, with parallel surveys for port agents and service providers.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a mandatory convention will directly affect compliance selection of coatings and cleaning solutions

entries.title: WashU 获美国国防部 75 万美元资助，研发软体机器人式"抖落"防污材料
entries.summary: 圣路易斯华盛顿大学 Christopher Cooper 团队联合北达科他州立大学，开发结合软体机器人和无毒聚合物、能随环境调整的多层防污系统。
entries.relevance_reason: 主动响应、无毒路线的前期研究，可关注后续数据
entries.title_en: WashU receives US$750,000 DoD funding to develop soft-robot "shake-off" antifouling materials
entries.summary_en: Christopher Cooper's team at Washington University in St. Louis, together with North Dakota State University, is developing a multilayer antifouling system combining soft robotics with non-toxic polymers that can adjust to the environment.
entries.relevance_reason_en: early-stage research on an active-response, non-toxic route; watch for follow-up data

entries.title: 上海海洋大学等揭示极地细菌 YadA 黏附素同时驱动腐蚀与生物污损
entries.summary: 研究在线发表于 Corrosion Science：极地嗜冷杆菌分泌的胞外蛋白远高于温带细菌，可加剧低温钢腐蚀，并对大型污损生物有更强的附着变态诱导作用，为靶向黏附素的防污设计提供依据。
entries.relevance_reason: 极地/低温航线防污防腐配方的机理依据
entries.title_en: Shanghai Ocean University and others reveal polar bacterial adhesin YadA drives both corrosion and biofouling
entries.summary_en: The study was published online in Corrosion Science: the polar psychrophilic bacterium secretes far more extracellular protein than temperate bacteria, which can aggravate low-temperature steel corrosion and more strongly induce attachment and metamorphosis of macrofouling organisms, providing a basis for adhesin-targeted antifouling design.
entries.relevance_reason_en: mechanistic basis for antifouling/anticorrosion formulations on polar / low-temperature routes

entries.title: Motorship 专访：Intersleek 2120 瞄准老龄散货船和油轮船队
entries.summary: AkzoNobel 认为在老旧船延寿背景下，应按全生命周期成本评估涂层；Intersleek 2120 报告航速损失最高 1.4%，涂装道数更少，无杀生剂硅表面适合水下清洗。
entries.relevance_reason: 低活动率散货/油轮航线的硅基污损释放选型参考
entries.title_en: Motorship interview: Intersleek 2120 targets ageing bulk carrier and tanker fleets
entries.summary_en: AkzoNobel argues that, against the backdrop of life extension for older ships, coatings should be assessed on whole-life cost; Intersleek 2120 reports speed loss of up to 1.4%, requires fewer coats, and its biocide-free silicone surface suits underwater cleaning.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a silicone fouling-release selection reference for low-activity bulk carrier / tanker routes

entries.title: 宁波舟山港船舶水下清洁机器人投入商业化运营
entries.summary: 智港通公司联合研发的机器人采用磁吸加推进器贴附、浑水摄像和空化射流，清洗一艘 200 m 船约 20 小时，宣称不伤船体油漆。
entries.relevance_reason: 港口清洗能力提升，间接影响宁波舟山港相关航线的维护策略
entries.title_en: Underwater hull-cleaning robot enters commercial operation at Ningbo-Zhoushan Port
entries.summary_en: The robot, co-developed by Zhigangtong, attaches by magnetic adhesion plus thrusters, with turbid-water imaging and cavitation jets; cleaning a 200 m ship takes about 20 hours, and it is claimed not to damage hull paint.
entries.relevance_reason_en: port cleaning capability improves, indirectly affecting maintenance strategies on routes related to Ningbo-Zhoushan Port

entries.title: AkzoNobel 将 International Micron 350 防污漆引入亚太市场
entries.summary: Micron 350 为自抛光防污漆，宣称最多两年防污，船舶静置时仍能保持防护，面向亚太热带、亚热带高污损水域的游艇市场。
entries.relevance_reason: 高污损热带水域的游艇自抛光产品，可作对照
entries.title_en: AkzoNobel brings International Micron 350 antifouling to the Asia-Pacific market
entries.summary_en: Micron 350 is a self-polishing antifouling paint, claimed to provide up to two years of antifouling protection and to keep protecting while the vessel is idle, aimed at the yacht market in tropical and subtropical high-fouling Asia-Pacific waters.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a yacht self-polishing product for high-fouling tropical waters, usable as a benchmark

entries.title: 德威涂料与华宇云通达成"涂料+水下机器人"战略合作
entries.summary: 双方 8 月 20 日签约，重点推广 G50 高固低粘防腐底漆与 G60 低表面能硬质防污漆配套，宣称 5–8 年质保、综合节能 10% 以上，G60 可适配水下机器人清洗；数据为企业口径。
entries.relevance_reason: 硬质可清洗防污漆+机器人维护的国产组合方案
entries.title_en: Dewei Coatings and Huayu Yuntong reach strategic cooperation on "coatings + underwater robots"
entries.summary_en: The two parties signed on 20 August, focusing on promoting the pairing of the G50 high-solids low-viscosity anticorrosive primer with the G60 low-surface-energy hard antifouling paint, claiming a 5–8 year warranty and overall energy savings above 10%, with the G60 compatible with underwater robot cleaning; the figures are company-stated.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a domestic combination of hard cleanable antifouling paint + robot maintenance

entries.title: 双瑞涂料完成"中宏27"集装箱船有机硅防污坞修涂装
entries.summary: 8 月 24 日"中宏27"在福建瀚海船业出坞；施工面临 76 cm 坞墩高度、不到原计划四分之三的坞期和台风天气，双瑞团队靠精细排程完成有机硅防污涂装。
entries.relevance_reason: 有机硅体系在紧坞期和恶劣气象下的施工可行性案例
entries.title_en: Sunrui completes silicone antifouling dry-dock coating on the container ship "Zhonghong 27"
entries.summary_en: On 24 August "Zhonghong 27" left dock at Fujian Hanhai Shipbuilding; the work faced 76 cm keel-block height, a docking period less than three quarters of the original plan, and typhoon weather, and the Sunrui team completed the silicone antifouling application through fine scheduling.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a case of silicone-system application feasibility under a tight docking window and bad weather

entries.title: Biofouling：压电陶瓷驱动超声振动防污
entries.summary: BITS Pilani 等团队在 Biofouling 在线发表超声振动防污研究，使用压电陶瓷执行器（信息来自 Crossref 元数据，期刊全文未打开）。
entries.relevance_reason: 非涂层路线，可作为辅助防污手段参考
entries.title_en: Biofouling: ultrasonic-vibration antifouling driven by piezoelectric ceramics
entries.summary_en: A team including BITS Pilani published an ultrasonic-vibration antifouling study online in Biofouling, using piezoelectric ceramic actuators (information from Crossref metadata; the journal full text was not opened).
entries.relevance_reason_en: a non-coating route; reference as an auxiliary antifouling method

entries.title: 青岛森科特第二批智能洗船机器人发往新加坡
entries.summary: 首台设备在新加坡投运后客户追加采购；机器人采用空化射流无损清洗，配抗浪流稳定控制，可在锚地和港内作业。
entries.relevance_reason: 国产清洗装备出海，与配方间接相关
entries.title_en: Qingdao Senkote ships second batch of intelligent hull-cleaning robots to Singapore
entries.summary_en: After the first unit entered service in Singapore, the customer ordered more; the robot uses cavitation-jet non-destructive cleaning with anti-wave/current stabilisation control, and can operate at anchorages and in port.
entries.relevance_reason_en: domestic cleaning equipment going overseas; indirectly related to formulations

entries.title: OCT 实时分析黄原胶水凝胶防污涂层
entries.summary: 研究用光学相干断层扫描结合流变学，考察惰性丙烯酸、松香、硅烷丙烯酸自抛光三种基料下黄原胶含量、粒径和 PVC/CPVC 比与盐度对凝胶形成和耐久性的影响，为减少杀生剂用量提供配方指导。
entries.relevance_reason: 直接涉及基料选择与 PVC/CPVC 等配方参数
entries.title_en: OCT real-time analysis of xanthan-gum hydrogel antifouling coatings
entries.summary_en: The study used optical coherence tomography combined with rheology to examine how xanthan gum content, particle size and PVC/CPVC ratio, together with salinity, affect gel formation and durability across three binders — inert acrylic, rosin, and silane-acrylic self-polishing — providing formulation guidance for reducing biocide use.
entries.relevance_reason_en: directly involves binder selection and formulation parameters such as PVC/CPVC

entries.title: Equal Routes 报告：加利福尼亚湾 LNG 扩张提高船源入侵物种风险
entries.summary: 报告认为拟建 LNG 出口码头会给加利福尼亚湾带来前所未有的油轮流量，压载水和生物污损可能引入入侵物种，现有法规与防控措施不足，呼吁预防先行。

entries.title_en: Equal Routes report: LNG expansion in the Gulf of California raises ship-borne invasive species risk
entries.summary_en: The report argues that proposed LNG export terminals would bring unprecedented tanker traffic to the Gulf of California, that ballast water and biofouling could introduce invasive species, that existing regulations and control measures are insufficient, and calls for prevention first.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a regional policy initiative that may affect future biofouling management requirements on Mexican routes

entries.title: ACS AMI：华南理工慢固化聚脲可剥离防污涂层
entries.summary: 以仲胺低聚硅氧烷纳米簇为交联剂，引入含氟和 PEG 侧链的反应性两亲聚合物，干燥时迁移到表面抑制污损；在钢、陶瓷、铜、玻璃等基材上附着力 2–8 MPa，可剥离便于维修（据 Crossref 摘要）。
entries.relevance_reason: 两亲表面迁移与可剥离设计适合设备/临时防护场景
entries.title_en: ACS AMI: South China University of Technology slow-curing polyurea peelable antifouling coating
entries.summary_en: Using secondary-amine oligosiloxane nanoclusters as the crosslinker and introducing a reactive amphiphilic polymer with fluorine and PEG side chains, which migrates to the surface on drying to inhibit fouling; adhesion of 2–8 MPa on substrates including steel, ceramic, copper and glass, and peelable for easy maintenance (per the Crossref abstract).
entries.relevance_reason_en: amphiphilic surface migration and peelable design suit equipment / temporary-protection scenarios

entries.title: MSC 与佐敦签署"始终清洁船体"协议，在 MSC Daniela 上安装 HSS
entries.summary: 方案将 SeaQuantum Skate 涂层与机器人主动检测、清洗结合；佐敦称 HSS 已获 DNV 独立验证，可实现无可测航速损失的清洁船体。
entries.relevance_reason: 大型集装箱船航线采用"涂层+清洗"捆绑方案，影响选型思路
entries.title_en: MSC and Jotun sign "always clean hull" agreement, HSS installed on MSC Daniela
entries.summary_en: The solution combines the SeaQuantum Skate coating with robotic proactive inspection and cleaning; Jotun states HSS has been independently verified by DNV and can achieve a clean hull with no measurable speed loss.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a major container-ship route adopting a bundled "coating + cleaning" solution, influencing selection thinking

entries.title: ACS Applied Polymer Materials：水解自抛光+pH 响应释放熊果苷的防污涂层
entries.summary: 大连海事大学团队以 PDMS-聚氨酯丙烯酸酯为可水解基体，负载熊果苷的 ZIF-8 与纳米 SiO₂ 实现响应释放和增强；60 天质量损失 0.6 mg/cm²，附着力 5B，剪切强度 14.1 MPa（据 Crossref 摘要）。
entries.relevance_reason: 天然防污剂+自抛光基体的配方组合，可直接借鉴
entries.title_en: ACS Applied Polymer Materials: hydrolytic self-polishing antifouling coating with pH-responsive arbutin release
entries.summary_en: A Dalian Maritime University team used a PDMS–polyurethane acrylate as a hydrolysable matrix, loaded with arbutin-bearing ZIF-8 and nano-SiO₂ for responsive release and reinforcement; 60-day mass loss 0.6 mg/cm², adhesion 5B, shear strength 14.1 MPa (per the Crossref abstract).
entries.relevance_reason_en: a formulation combination of natural antifoulant + self-polishing matrix that can be drawn on directly

entries.title: 海化院有机硅防污涂料首次实船用于 30 万吨级 VLCC

entries.title_en: Marine Chemical Research Institute silicone antifouling coating used on a 300,000-tonne VLCC for the first time
entries.summary_en: The VLCC "Island Splendor" left dock on 30 July after completing dry-docking in Zhoushan; the report says this is the first time a domestically produced high-performance marine coating has been used on a VLCC. The in-service estimates cited in the article — speed loss of 1.5%–2% and fuel savings of 11%–13% — are company figures and have not been independently verified.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a domestic low-surface-energy silicone system entering large tanker service can serve as a fouling-release candidate reference

entries.title: 华南理工张广照团队可控降解防污涂料实现规模化应用
entries.summary: 涂料以聚酯-聚氨酯、聚酯-聚丙烯酸酯等可控降解聚合物为主体，靠海水水解酯基实现逐层降解、表面动态更新来抑制附着，不依赖传统有毒杀生剂；已用于中远海运船舶及波浪能平台、海底数据中心、海洋牧场等场景。
entries.relevance_reason: 降解型自更新树脂是低杀生剂/无杀生剂配方的核心路线之一
entries.title_en: South China University of Technology team led by Guangzhao Zhang achieves scaled-up application of controllably degradable antifouling coatings
entries.summary_en: The coatings are based on controllably degradable polymers such as polyester–polyurethane and polyester–polyacrylate; hydrolysis of ester groups in seawater drives layer-by-layer degradation and dynamic surface renewal to inhibit attachment, without relying on traditional toxic biocides. They have been applied on COSCO Shipping vessels and in scenarios including wave-energy platforms, subsea data centres, and marine ranches.
entries.relevance_reason_en: degradable self-renewing resins are one of the core routes for low-biocide / biocide-free formulations

entries.summary_en: Lujian Technology used an underwater cleaning robot to clean the hull of the vessel Huizhong 5, removing attached organisms such as sea anemones and barnacles; it was described as Shandong Port Logistics Group's first intelligent underwater vessel-cleaning job. entries.relevance_reason: 两亲表面+自抛光的商用配方思路，可作为远洋航线 SPC 候选对照
entries.title_en: KCC launches nano-acrylic self-polishing antifouling EgisPacific(LF)
entries.summary_en: Positioned between the flagship MetaCruise NS and the economy range, aimed at mainstream ocean-going fleets, and claimed to provide long-lasting protection of about 5 years; it uses dual-layer nanocapsule acrylic technology and an amphiphilic surface, and contains no organotin.
entries.relevance_reason_en: the commercial formulation approach of an amphiphilic surface plus self-polishing can serve as an SPC candidate benchmark for ocean-going routes

entries.title: UMCES 牵头 24 位科学家警告：霍尔木兹海峡滞留船舶或引发生物入侵"超级传播"事件
entries.summary: 论文发表于 Biological Invasions：海峡自 2026-02-28 关闭后大量商船在海湾长期锚泊，船体被细菌、藻类、藤壶等快速附着；船舶恢复航行后可能把入侵物种带往全球港口，作者提出离港前清洗与评估等建议。
entries.relevance_reason: 长期锚泊/低航速工况凸显静态防污能力，对热带海湾航线的涂层选型有参考价值
entries.title_en: UMCES leads 24 scientists in warning that vessels stranded in the Strait of Hormuz could trigger a bioinvasion "super-spreader" event
entries.summary_en: The paper was published in Biological Invasions: since the strait closed on 2026-02-28, large numbers of merchant vessels have been anchored for long periods in the Gulf, with bacteria, algae, barnacles and other organisms rapidly attaching to their hulls; once the vessels resume sailing they may carry invasive species to ports worldwide, and the authors recommend cleaning and assessment before departure, among other measures.
entries.relevance_reason_en: long anchorage / low-speed conditions highlight static antifouling capability, a useful reference for coating selection on tropical Gulf routes

entries.title: 哈电海洋智装发布船舶清洗型 ROV「水下清道夫」
entries.summary: 设备采用双足履带贴附船体、空化射流清洗盘，可自主规划清洗路径并实时回传影像，配 4 台水平和 4 台垂直推进器，适配 0–150 m 水深，已在威海远遥码头完成海试。
entries.relevance_reason: 清洗装备，与涂层耐清洗性间接相关
entries.title_en: Harbin Electric Marine Equipment launches hull-cleaning ROV "Underwater Sweeper"
entries.summary_en: The device uses bipedal tracks to attach to the hull and a cavitation-jet cleaning disc, can plan cleaning paths autonomously and transmit imagery in real time, is fitted with 4 horizontal and 4 vertical thrusters, suits water depths of 0–150 m, and has completed sea trials at Weihai Yuanyao Terminal.
entries.relevance_reason_en: cleaning equipment, indirectly related to coatings' resistance to cleaning

entries.title: 信和仿生有机硅防污漆用于冰区超大灵便型船坞修
entries.summary: 大连中远海运重工完成一艘冰区航行超大灵便型船坞修，全船采用信和冰区专用防护涂料和仿生有机硅防污漆，涂装窗口仅 4 天 3 晚，一次性通过完工报验。
entries.relevance_reason: 冰区航线上有机硅防污与破冰漆配套的国产案例
entries.title_en: Xinhe biomimetic silicone antifouling used in dry-docking of an ice-class ultramax vessel
entries.summary_en: Dalian COSCO Shipping Heavy Industry completed the dry-docking of an ice-going ultramax vessel, with Xinhe ice-zone protective coatings and biomimetic silicone antifouling applied over the whole vessel, a coating window of only 4 days and 3 nights, and a one-pass completion inspection.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a domestic case of silicone antifouling paired with ice-breaking paint on ice-zone routes

entries.title: PPG SIGMAGLIDE 2390 获美国化学会绿色化学挑战奖
entries.summary: 这款无杀生剂有机硅污损释放涂层获「更安全化学品设计」类奖项；它采用 HYDRORESET 技术，遇水后表面在纳米尺度重排，形成超光滑、低摩擦界面，可静电喷涂。PPG 称第三方按 ISO 19030/ITTC 评估，功率最多可节省 20%。
entries.relevance_reason: 无杀生剂 FRC 商用标杆获权威认可，节能数字为厂商口径
entries.title_en: PPG SIGMAGLIDE 2390 receives the American Chemical Society Green Chemistry Challenge Award
entries.summary_en: This biocide-free silicone fouling-release coating won in the "Designing Greener Chemicals" category; it uses HYDRORESET technology, in which the surface rearranges at the nanoscale on contact with water to form an ultra-smooth, low-friction interface, and it can be applied by electrostatic spraying. PPG states that third-party assessment to ISO 19030/ITTC showed power savings of up to 20%.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a commercial benchmark for biocide-free FRC gains authoritative recognition; the energy-saving figures are company-stated

entries.title: 瑞丰动力试产 4 台船舶清洗机器人，预计 8 月交付
entries.summary: 由北京汇智国科设计，初步设计清洗效率大于 1000 m²/h，导航精度 ±5 cm，缺陷识别率约 92%，最大作业水深 300 m；公告注明规格基于设计参数，仍需测试和客户验收。
entries.relevance_reason: 清洗装备，规格尚未经验收，对配方选择属间接影响
entries.title_en: Ruifeng Power trial-produces 4 hull-cleaning robots, with delivery expected in August
entries.summary_en: Designed by Beijing Huizhi Guoke, with preliminary design figures of cleaning efficiency above 1,000 m²/h, navigation accuracy of ±5 cm, a defect recognition rate of about 92%, and a maximum working depth of 300 m; the announcement notes the specifications are based on design parameters and still require testing and customer acceptance.
entries.relevance_reason_en: cleaning equipment whose specifications have not yet been accepted, with an indirect effect on formulation choice

entries.title: 挪威研究：从机器人洗船回收物中用 eDNA 检出 19 种外来物种
entries.summary: NINA 和挪威海洋研究所分析在 Tananger 和卑尔根用 ECOsubsea 机器人清洗的 9 艘船的回收物和洗水，检出 19 种尚未在挪威定殖的外来物种，其中 8 种为高风险「门口物种」，一艘国际邮轮携带最多；港口水样中未检出这些物种。
entries.relevance_reason: 带捕集清洗可用于生物安全监测，北欧航线对捕集清洗的要求可能进一步强化
entries.title_en: Norwegian study: eDNA detects 19 alien species in material recovered from robot hull cleaning
entries.summary_en: NINA and the Norwegian Institute of Marine Research analysed recovered material and wash water from 9 vessels cleaned by ECOsubsea robots at Tananger and Bergen, detecting 19 alien species not yet established in Norway, 8 of them high-risk "doorstep species", with an international cruise ship carrying the most; these species were not detected in port water samples.
entries.relevance_reason_en: cleaning with capture can be used for biosecurity monitoring, and requirements for capture cleaning on Nordic routes may be further strengthened

entries.title: 佐敦中远海运涂料与中远海运散运签署 125 艘新造散货船合作备忘录
entries.summary: 6 月 26 日在博鳌签署，船队将使用高性能防污涂层体系，部分船舶将视工况评估使用 Hull Skating Solutions。
entries.relevance_reason: 大型国内船东新造船批量选型，反映散货船主流防污方案
entries.title_en: Jotun COSCO Marine Coatings signs cooperation MOU with COSCO Shipping Bulk for 125 newbuilding bulk carriers
entries.summary_en: Signed on 26 June at Boao, the agreement covers a fleet that will use high-performance antifouling coating systems, with some vessels to be assessed for Hull Skating Solutions depending on operating conditions.
entries.relevance_reason_en: batch selection by a large domestic shipowner for newbuildings, reflecting mainstream antifouling solutions for bulk carriers

entries.title: 双瑞涂料上半年完成六艘船有机硅防污涂装
entries.summary: 6 月 29 日「金海正」轮在南通完工，上半年累计完成「金海辉」「新红宝石」「金海鑫」「金海众」「华海航2」「金海正」六船；报道提到梅雨期高湿环境下需监测露点和湿度、动态调整稀释比例与喷涂节奏。
entries.relevance_reason: 高湿环境下有机硅施工控制的实务经验，对施工窗口评估有参考价值
entries.title_en: Shuangrui coatings completes silicone antifouling application on six vessels in the first half of the year
entries.summary_en: On 29 June, the vessel Jinhai Zheng was completed at Nantong, bringing the first-half total to six vessels: Jinhai Hui, Xin Hongbaoshi, Jinhai Xin, Jinhai Zhong, Huahaihang 2 and Jinhai Zheng; the report noted that in the high-humidity environment of the plum-rain season, dew point and humidity need monitoring, with dilution ratios and spraying pace adjusted dynamically.
entries.relevance_reason_en: practical experience of silicone application control in high-humidity environments, a useful reference for assessing application windows

entries.title: IMCA 警示霍尔木兹复航期间水下船舶维护作业风险上升
entries.summary: 国际海事承包商协会指出，水下船舶维护（含船体清洗）需求随海峡复航激增，而这类作业是商业潜水中最危险的领域之一；协会呼吁选用合格承包商，采用水面供气潜水而非 SCUBA，并参照 IMCA D082 指南。
entries.relevance_reason: 侧重作业安全，对配方影响间接
entries.title_en: IMCA warns of rising risk in underwater ship husbandry as Hormuz traffic resumes
entries.summary_en: The International Marine Contractors Association notes that demand for underwater ship husbandry (including hull cleaning) is surging as the strait reopens, while such work is among the most dangerous areas of commercial diving; the association calls for using qualified contractors, surface-supplied diving rather than SCUBA, and following the IMCA D082 guidelines.
entries.relevance_reason_en: focused on operational safety, with only an indirect effect on formulations

entries.title: Progress in Organic Coatings：姜黄素接枝 SiO₂/PDMS 纳米复合防污涂层通过 180 天实海测试
entries.summary: Lei 等人用 RAFT 聚合把姜黄素和 N-乙烯基吡咯烷酮接枝到黄原酸酯功能化的二氧化硅上，作为活性填料加入羟基封端 PDMS，结合自抛光、酯键水解缓释姜黄素和低表面能污损释放三种机制，180 天实海测试中防污效果稳定。
entries.relevance_reason: 天然产物缓释与 PDMS 结合的多机制思路，对配方设计有参考价值
entries.title_en: Progress in Organic Coatings: curcumin-grafted SiO₂/PDMS nanocomposite antifouling coating passes a 180-day real-sea test
entries.summary_en: Lei et al. used RAFT polymerisation to graft curcumin and N-vinylpyrrolidone onto xanthate-functionalised silica, added it as an active filler to hydroxyl-terminated PDMS, and combined three mechanisms — self-polishing, slow release of curcumin through ester-bond hydrolysis, and low-surface-energy fouling release; antifouling performance remained stable in a 180-day real-sea test.
entries.relevance_reason_en: the multi-mechanism approach combining natural-product slow release with PDMS is a useful reference for formulation design

entries.title: 霍尔木兹海峡滞留船舶大面积污损，清洗需求激增
entries.summary: 约 600 艘船因海峡关闭在波斯湾滞留数月，船体被藤壶、贻贝和藻类覆盖，需大批潜水员清理后才能复航；BIMCO 人士称清洗费用已涨到每船五位数美元，清洗时还需避免损伤防污涂层。
entries.relevance_reason: 温水长期锚泊是防污涂层最严苛的工况，与中东航线选型直接相关
entries.title_en: Vessels stranded in the Strait of Hormuz heavily fouled; cleaning demand surges
entries.summary_en: Around 600 vessels have been stranded in the Persian Gulf for months because of the strait closure, their hulls covered with barnacles, mussels and algae; large numbers of divers are needed to clean them before they can resume sailing, and a BIMCO representative said cleaning costs have risen to five figures in USD per vessel, with care also needed during cleaning to avoid damaging the antifouling coating.
entries.relevance_reason_en: long anchorage in warm water is the most severe operating condition for antifouling coatings, directly relevant to selection for Middle East routes

entries.title: IMO 在斐济举办水下清洗研讨会，协助制定国家监管方案
entries.summary: 6 月 2–3 日，斐济政府部门和 14 家私营机构在 Lami Bay 研讨如何落实 IMO 水下清洗指南（MEPC.1/Circ.918），议题包括按航迹和涂层类型、状况、龄期评估清洗影响，是否要求捕集以及如何验证效果；属 IMO–Norad TEST Biofouling 项目。
entries.relevance_reason: 太平洋岛国开始建立清洗监管，涂层类型和状况会被纳入清洗审批考量
entries.title_en: IMO holds in-water cleaning workshop in Fiji to help develop national regulatory schemes
entries.summary_en: On 2–3 June, Fijian government departments and 14 private-sector organisations met in Lami Bay to discuss how to implement the IMO in-water cleaning guidelines (MEPC.1/Circ.918); topics included assessing cleaning impact by sailing profile and by coating type, condition and age, whether capture should be required, and how to verify effectiveness; the workshop was part of the IMO–Norad TEST Biofouling project.
entries.relevance_reason_en: Pacific island states are beginning to establish cleaning regulation, and coating type and condition will be factored into cleaning approval considerations

entries.title: 南卡罗来纳大学获 ONR 资助，用计算模拟设计两性离子防污材料
entries.summary: Tao Wei 团队 5 月起开展新项目，用多尺度模拟研究材料表面水化层，设计能适应静态和航行工况、以及不同盐度和酸度的两性离子防污聚合物涂层。
entries.relevance_reason: 处于基础研究阶段，短期不影响配方选型
entries.title_en: University of South Carolina receives ONR funding to design zwitterionic antifouling materials with computational simulation
entries.summary_en: Tao Wei's team began a new project in May, using multiscale simulation to study the hydration layer at material surfaces and to design zwitterionic antifouling polymer coatings that can adapt to both static and underway conditions, and to different salinities and acidities.
entries.relevance_reason_en: still at the fundamental research stage, with no near-term impact on formulation selection

entries.title: Chalmers 研究：游艇防污漆比较中，无杀生剂有机硅表现最好
entries.summary: 在瑞典、丹麦、法国三地挂板最长 6 个月：有机硅无杀生剂涂料防污效果最好，含三氟甲吡醚（tralopyril）和吡啶硫酮锌的涂料次之但释放量远超可接受水平；5 种氧化亚铜含量 6–32 wt% 的涂料防污效果相近，低铜同样有效。论文发表于 Journal of Hazardous Materials。
entries.relevance_reason: 直接支持降低铜含量和选择 FRC 的配方决策，并提示 tralopyril 的环境风险
entries.title_en: Chalmers study: among yacht antifouling paints compared, biocide-free silicone performs best
entries.summary_en: In panel tests of up to 6 months at sites in Sweden, Denmark and France, silicone biocide-free coatings gave the best antifouling performance; coatings containing tralopyril and zinc pyrithione came next but released far more than acceptable levels; five coatings with cuprous oxide contents of 6–32 wt% performed similarly, and low copper was equally effective. The paper was published in the Journal of Hazardous Materials.
entries.relevance_reason_en: directly supports formulation decisions to lower copper content and select FRC, and flags the environmental risk of tralopyril

entries.title: GIT Coatings 在 Posidonia 推出石墨烯螺旋桨涂层 XGIT-VORTEX
entries.summary: 三层体系：污损释放面漆抑制附着，增强中间层抵抗空蚀应力；厂商称最多可省油 5%，并在 LR 展台获颁型式认可证书。
entries.relevance_reason: 螺旋桨专用涂层，与船体防污配方关系有限
entries.title_en: GIT Coatings launches graphene propeller coating XGIT-VORTEX at Posidonia
entries.summary_en: A three-layer system: a fouling-release topcoat suppresses attachment, and a reinforced intermediate layer resists cavitation stress; the company states fuel savings of up to 5%, and a type approval certificate was presented at the Lloyd's Register stand.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a propeller-specific coating, with limited relevance to hull antifouling formulations

entries.title: 巴西 NORMAM-401 生物污损规定 6 月 10 日生效，处罚推迟至 2028 年 1 月
entries.summary: 规定与 IMO MEPC.207(62) 一致，要求船上备有生物污损管理计划和记录簿，船体只允许微污损，出现 2 级及以上宏观污损才需清洗且需事先获批；违规最高罚款 200 万雷亚尔，可能被滞留，但处罚预计到 2028 年 1 月才执行。
entries.relevance_reason: 直接影响南美航线的防污涂层选型和清洗计划
entries.title_en: Brazil's NORMAM-401 biofouling rules take effect on 10 June, with penalties deferred to January 2028
entries.summary_en: The rules align with IMO MEPC.207(62) and require ships to carry a Biofouling Management Plan and Record Book; only microfouling is permitted on the hull, cleaning is required only at macrofouling of level 2 or above and needs prior approval; violations carry fines of up to R$2 million and possible detention, but enforcement of penalties is not expected until January 2028.
entries.relevance_reason_en: directly affects antifouling coating selection and cleaning planning on South American routes

entries.title: International 在 Posidonia 推出 Intersleek 2120 有机硅污损释放涂层
entries.summary: 面向从含杀生剂 SPC 体系转型的散货船、油轮等，标称航速损失最低可到 1.4%；与现有有机硅体系相比所需涂层道数更少，可缩短施工和坞期。
entries.relevance_reason: 面向主流散货/油轮的无杀生剂 FRC 候选，可直接纳入商用对标
entries.title_en: International launches Intersleek 2120 silicone fouling-release coating at Posidonia
entries.summary_en: Aimed at bulk carriers, tankers and similar vessels transitioning away from biocide-containing SPC systems, with a stated speed loss as low as 1.4%; it requires fewer coats than existing silicone systems, shortening application and docking time.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a biocide-free FRC candidate aimed at mainstream bulk/tanker fleets; can go straight into commercial benchmarking

entries.title: DNV 新增验证 Jotun SeaQuantum 系列航速损失
entries.summary: 按 ISO 19030 方法和在役数据，SeaQuantum III/S 系列平均航速损失 1.8%，SeaQuantum Pro U 平均 2.5%；此前 SeaQuantum X200 为 1.0%，HSS 无可测航速损失。
entries.relevance_reason: 经第三方验证的 SPC 航速损失数据，可作为商用产品对标基准
entries.title_en: DNV newly verifies speed loss of Jotun's SeaQuantum range
entries.summary_en: Using ISO 19030 methods and in-service data, average speed loss was 1.8% for SeaQuantum III/S and 2.5% for SeaQuantum Pro U; previously, SeaQuantum X200 was 1.0% and HSS showed no measurable speed loss.
entries.relevance_reason_en: third-party verified SPC speed-loss data; usable as a benchmark for commercial products

entries.title: 双瑞有机硅防污漆完成「华海航2」号四船拼坞六天涂装
entries.summary: 舟山华丰修船厂同坞四船交叉作业、坞期 6 天；厂商称产品复涂间隔宽容、固化快，可降低燃油消耗 3%–8%，单次涂装综合成本降低 30%–40%，不含杀生剂。数字为厂商口径，未经独立核实。
entries.relevance_reason: 国产有机硅 FRC 在散货船坞修中的施工适配性案例
entries.title_en: Shuangrui silicone antifouling paint completes six-day coating of four vessels in one dock for "Huahai Hang 2"
entries.summary_en: Four vessels were worked cross-wise in the same dock at Zhoushan Huafeng shipyard over a 6-day docking; the company states the product has a tolerant recoating interval and fast curing, can reduce fuel consumption by 3%–8%, and lowers the overall cost of a single coating application by 30%–40%, with no biocides. The figures are company-reported and have not been independently verified.
entries.relevance_reason_en: an application-compatibility case for a domestic silicone FRC in bulk carrier dry-dock repair

entries.summary: 已有 5 艘 LPG 船完成涂装（另 1 艘在坞）。案例船涂装后平均船体粗糙度 60–70 μm，出坞功率比旧涂层改善约 6%，配合船载机器人主动清洗一年多未见硬质污损；首艘使用新一代 XGIT-FORCE 的船平均粗糙度为 38 μm。以上为厂商和船东口径。

entries.title_en: BW Epic Kosan expands use of GIT Coatings' biocide-free graphene coatings
entries.summary_en: Five LPG carriers have been coated so far (with one more in dock). On the case vessels, average hull roughness after coating was 60–70 μm and out-of-dock power improved by about 6% versus the old coating; combined with proactive cleaning by onboard robots, no hard fouling was seen for over a year; the first vessel using the new-generation XGIT-FORCE had an average roughness of 38 μm. The above is as reported by the manufacturer and the shipowner.
entries.relevance_reason_en: in-service data for a hard fouling-release coating combined with proactive cleaning; a reference for cleanability metrics

entries.summary_en: DNV assessed underwater inspection data from 33 vessels and performance monitoring from 12 vessels over an average of 3.5 years (per ISO 19030, including a 1-year baseline period), confirming that hulls using HSS remained essentially free of fouling with no measurable speed loss over the observation period.

entries.relevance_reason: 近海高污损、低速工况下用有机硅体系，对航线选型很有参考价值
entries.title_en: 725th Research Institute completes silicone biomimetic drag-reduction antifouling coating on "Rui Lu Hao"
entries.summary_en: The vessel trades along China's southern, eastern and northern coasts and left dock in early May; the report stresses that nutrient-rich nearshore waters and long low-speed berthing mean both fouling pressure and coating wear are higher than in ocean service, and this application is seen as a validation of silicone biomimetic coatings on high-frequency nearshore vessels.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a silicone system used in high-fouling nearshore, low-speed conditions; very relevant as a reference for route-based selection
