entries.relevance_reason: 国产无锡 SPC 的实船应用案例，可作为短坞期场景的参考
entries.title_en: Xinhe Wuxi self-polishing antifouling paint used in dry-dock repair of a 114,000-tonne Aframax tanker
entries.summary_en: The docking lasted only 4 days, overlapping with cross-trades work such as welding and plate renewal; the company states the product suits high-pressure airless spraying, cures quickly, has a controllable hydrolysis rate and is tin-free. The above is company-stated.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a full-scale application case for a domestic tin-free SPC, a useful reference for short-docking scenarios

entries.title: 魁北克 PAINTS 项目：无杀生剂干凝胶与有机硅涂层多地挂板测试
entries.summary: 魁北克与法国研究团队在 Rimouski、Sept-Îles、土伦、洛里昂和留尼汪等地测试 8 种干凝胶和有机硅涂层；部分无杀生剂涂层效果略逊于含杀生剂涂料，但有实际防污效果且环境安全，耐久性仍需提升，尚未到大规模商业化阶段。
entries.relevance_reason: 冷水到热带多海域对比，对无杀生剂配方的地域适用性有参考
entries.title_en: Quebec PAINTS project: multi-site panel testing of biocide-free xerogel and silicone coatings
entries.summary_en: Research teams in Quebec and France tested 8 xerogel and silicone coatings at sites including Rimouski, Sept-Îles, Toulon, Lorient and Réunion; some biocide-free coatings performed slightly worse than biocide-containing paints but showed real antifouling effect and are environmentally safe, durability still needs improvement, and they are not yet at the stage of large-scale commercialisation.
entries.relevance_reason_en: comparisons across waters from cold to tropical; a reference for the regional applicability of biocide-free formulations

entries.title: I-Tech 发布藤壶污损风险白皮书：涂层选型是关键风险因素
entries.summary: 白皮书基于 Safinah Group 的坞检数据：686 艘船中超过三分之一进坞时藤壶覆盖率超过 10%，近五分之一超过 20%；污损释放涂层在长期闲置、温水和低速工况、以及涂层机械损伤处更容易被藤壶附着。含 Selektope 的实验性污损释放体系在涂层受损时仍表现出抗藤壶附着能力。
entries.relevance_reason: 直接对应 SPC 与 FRC 的选型逻辑，以及温水、长闲置航线的风险判断；注意为厂商白皮书
entries.title_en: I-Tech releases barnacle fouling risk white paper: coating selection is a key risk factor
entries.summary_en: The white paper is based on Safinah Group dry-dock inspection data: of 686 vessels, more than one third entered dock with barnacle coverage above 10%, and nearly one fifth above 20%; fouling-release coatings are more prone to barnacle settlement during long idle periods, in warm water and low-speed service, and at areas of mechanical coating damage. An experimental fouling-release system containing Selektope still showed resistance to barnacle settlement where the coating was damaged.
entries.relevance_reason_en: maps directly onto the SPC vs FRC selection logic and risk assessment for warm-water, long-idle routes; note that it is a vendor white paper

entries.relevance_reason_en: a mandatory convention will directly affect antifouling coating selection, inspection and cleaning requirements, and compliance costs on every route

entries.title: HullPIC 2026：业界呼吁提高船体性能数据透明度

entries.relevance_reason: 性能声明口径统一后，商用涂层之间的横向比较会更可靠
entries.title_en: HullPIC 2026: industry calls for greater transparency in hull performance data
entries.summary_en: The 11th HullPIC was held in Italy with more than 90 shipowners, service providers, coating manufacturers and experts attending; participants including Jotun argued that linking hull performance measurement with biofouling management is a core industry challenge, and that standardised, comparable performance claims based on methods such as ISO 19030 are needed.
entries.relevance_reason_en: once performance claim conventions are unified, cross-comparisons between commercial coatings will become more reliable

weeks.trend_summary: 本周材料偏少。新加坡以政府资助方式推动港内机器人检测清洗试验，清洗服务商同步扩产，说明「主动清洗+涂层」的组合正在主要枢纽港落地。超声波等非涂料防污手段开始在小型港作船上试用，但尚无公开性能数据。

entries.title: 新加坡 MPA 选定六家合作方开展港内水下船体检测与清洗创新试验
entries.summary: MPA 从 36 家公司的 19 份提案中选出 Alicia Bots、C-Leanship、Neptune Robotics、Oceanis Robotics、RINA 和 SEAHI Robotics，由 MINT 基金提供近 370 万新元研发共同资助；试验自 2026 年下半年起为期 18 个月，重点解决螺旋桨、舵、海底门等复杂部位、强流作业和污物收集要求。
entries.relevance_reason: 新加坡是东南亚高污损航线枢纽，港内机器人清洗普及会提高对涂层耐清洗性的要求
entries.title_en: Singapore's MPA selects six partners for in-port underwater hull inspection and cleaning innovation trials
entries.summary_en: The MPA selected Alicia Bots, C-Leanship, Neptune Robotics, Oceanis Robotics, RINA and SEAHI Robotics from 19 proposals submitted by 36 companies, with nearly S$3.7 million in R&D co-funding from the MINT fund; the trials will run for 18 months from the second half of 2026, focusing on complex areas such as propellers, rudders and sea chests, operations in strong currents, and debris collection requirements.
entries.relevance_reason_en: Singapore is a hub for high-fouling Southeast Asian routes; wider adoption of in-port robotic cleaning will raise requirements on coating cleanability

entries.title: 川崎汽船旗下拖轮 BISAN MARU 下水，成为日本首艘装超声波船体防污系统的拖轮
entries.summary: 该船由 SEAGATE 订造，同时配备生物燃料调和装置和 M-SAT 公司的超声波防污系统，用超声波抑制海生物附着；系统原为 2027 年交付的混合动力电动拖轮开发，先在本船上做实船验证，预计 2026 年 8 月在水岛港投入使用。
entries.relevance_reason: 非涂料路线的辅助防污手段，目前仅限港作拖轮验证
entries.title_en: Kawasaki Kisen tug BISAN MARU launched, becoming Japan's first tug fitted with an ultrasonic hull antifouling system
entries.summary_en: Ordered by SEAGATE, the vessel is fitted with both a biofuel blending unit and an ultrasonic antifouling system from M-SAT, which uses ultrasound to suppress marine growth; the system was originally developed for a hybrid-electric tug to be delivered in 2027 and is being validated in service on this vessel first, with entry into service at Mizushima Port expected in August 2026.
entries.relevance_reason_en: a non-coating supplementary antifouling method, currently only being validated on a harbour tug

entries.title: Neptune Robotics 投资 1200 万美元在新加坡建制造与研发基地
entries.summary: 该公司计划把自主船体清洗能力扩大五倍、到 2027 年达到每天 60 次清洗；新基地聚焦计算机视觉和机器学习，目标在低能见度和最高 4 节海流下全天候作业，目前服务网络覆盖新加坡和中国 61 个港口。
entries.relevance_reason: 清洗服务商扩张，对配方选择属间接影响
entries.title_en: Neptune Robotics invests US$12 million in a Singapore manufacturing and R&D base
entries.summary_en: The company plans to expand its autonomous hull cleaning capacity fivefold, reaching 60 cleanings per day by 2027; the new base focuses on computer vision and machine learning, aiming for round-the-clock operation in low visibility and currents of up to 4 knots, with a service network currently covering 61 ports in Singapore and China.
entries.relevance_reason_en: expansion of a cleaning service provider; only an indirect influence on formulation choices

weeks.nature_en: Industry news / public sources, not performance data. Backfilled; every item checked against its original source for date and content.
weeks.trend_summary_en: Material was thin this week. Singapore is using government funding to push in-port robotic inspection and cleaning trials while cleaning service providers expand capacity in parallel, showing that the "proactive cleaning + coating" combination is taking hold at major hub ports. Non-coating antifouling methods such as ultrasound are starting trials on small harbour craft, but no public performance data is available yet.

uvc_principles: UV-C 可损伤微生物 DNA/RNA 与部分幼体，抑制定殖或杀死早期生物膜。
船体应用面临：**水衰减、阴影、距离、LED 输出稳定性、聚合物/涂层光老化、功耗与密封**。
更现实的落点：niche 区（海箱、推进器隧道、传感器窗）、移动式/ROV 照射、嵌入式 LED 瓷砖试点——而非已验证的「整船外壳唯一方案」。
us_principles: 换能器在壳板激励振动/导波，干扰幼体附着或破坏早期生物膜；**预防优于清除**。
效果强烈依赖：**频率、功率、换能器间距与布局、壳板几何与阻尼、电源占空比**。
现场结果不一致：部分试验板洁净，部分商用系统对藤壶有抑制但对水线藻类/粘液/水螅类不足。

entries.points: 调查 UV 用于船舶防污的可行性与实践约束；间歇投影 UV-C 可使小面积浸没表面保持相对洁净，但阴影与衰减限制推广
将 UVC 灯结合 ROV：周频至每周三次、单次约 8–16 s 量级照射在试验中**不足以**长期维持；提示需更高剂量/时长或与清洗联用
